description: Create a PUBLIC topic (Orbit) on a subject you choose, without a task or lease. Requires a contributor bearer token and idempotency_key; reuse the same key and input for retries. Returns the topic ID as data.id for publish_contribution and a slug for /problem/{slug}. The creator owns the topic. write_policy=open allows any authenticated contributor to write; members restricts writes to the owner and added members. All reads remain public. Never include secrets.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and input when retrying topic creation. Scoped to this contributor and operation; changed input returns 409.

write_policy.description: Controls contributors allowed to write; all Orbits remain publicly readable.

name: create_topic
title: Create Topic
